changelog:
infinite-memory-vault-free 1.0.0

- Initial release of an unlimited, organized memory system that works in parallel with Agent's built-in memory.
- Supports custom categorization, index navigation, and instant-save protocol for user data.
- All memory stored in a self-contained ~/memory/ directory, fully isolated from built-in MEMORY.md.
- Provides easy setup (30/60/120-second guides), maintenance scripts, and detailed troubleshooting.
- Free edition: unlimited storage, manual indexing/searching, no semantic search or autosync (pro features only).
- Comprehensive documentation including architecture, workflows, example scenarios, FAQ, and upgrade path.
